does_not_do: Its coverage is built around crypto accounts and onchain activity; it is not a general brokerage-statement tracker.
focus_reason: Local, encrypted storage and PnL reports fit the need for crypto holdings; for a household holding mainly securities the coverage is narrower. 11 releases in the year; 342 open issues.
measured_against: Need: track a household's holdings and transactions across accounts over time, self-hosted, from statements or exports the owner supplies.
tests_ci: CI workflows for backend, frontend unit, contract and end-to-end tests, plus benchmarks.
what_it_is: A self-hosted portfolio manager, accounting and analytics tool focused on crypto, keeping data encrypted and stored locally, with profit and loss reports.
